dedupe_keys.name: synthetic event log for reproducibility of improving organizational processes in healthcare through simulation driven resource allocation methodology and real world case study

description: Francesco Vinci and colleagues at the universities of Padua and Pisa publish a synthetic emergency-department event log together with the process model used for simulation. The files are synlog_emergency_department.csv and model_emergency_department.bpmn. The authors generated the log to preserve structural and behavioural characteristics of a real hospital case while protecting the original observations. These inputs can support reproduction of resource-allocation experiments and tests of process-simulation methods. The deposit dates from February 2026; the hospital location, underlying observation period and event timestamp resolution are unknown from the inspected metadata. Both files are publicly listed on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, with free access. Synthetic events should not be interpreted as observed patient trajectories, and the claimed similarity to the original data was not independently tested. No related catalogue record is identified by the source.
